title: RAMADA by One Development
description: RAMADA by One Development — branded residences Ramada Residences by Wyndham Batumi (One Development): the first project of this format in the city's tourist centre, Heroes Alley; address reference — 10 Pirosmani St. (about 435 m to the sea per developer materials). Premium service and management — River Rock Hotels & Resorts (experience in property and rental management). On-site: pool and lounge, restaurant, gym, sky bar, parking (including up to 5 levels), interiors to Ramada by Wyndham standards. Handover — Q4 2029 (per promotional materials). Brochures cite indicative short-term rental yields and value growth — not guaranteed; current terms, prices and documents — sales department and onedev.ge.
